name: Abdon
overview: Abdon was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak. His mention in Scripture is concise, with no additional notes provided beyond his lineage. This brief record situates him within the genealogical framework of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Abdon means 'servant' in Hebrew. It is a proper name found in the biblical text, though it was not given directly by God. This meaning aligns with the biblical theme of faithful service.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Abdon as the son of Shashak. No other family relationships are documented in the provided data, so his family background beyond this is not detailed in Scripture.
scriptureSignificance: Abdon's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:23. His mention underscores the importance of preserving the lineage and heritage of the tribes of Israel. While no further narrative role is assigned to him, his inclusion reflects the biblical emphasis on family lines and tribal identity.
